answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via hardware enclave attestation. Agents must present cryptographic quotes from secure silicon, forcing attackers to incur the scarce cost of buying physical processors per identity instead of virtual instances. Relays spanning urban hubs and rural cedar groves verify these proofs, stopping rogue nodes from mimicking honest peers like a raven or branching into a lotus topology. However, this creates centralized reliance on proprietary chip manufacturers.
